_about: Versioned certification record for every advertised Runtime Provider Interface route (#596). Provider cells are capabilities.json's supported_profiles x supported_harnesses per provider; harness cells are base.py's launch table x {ro, rw}. Each route group names its tier, evidence paths, explicit limitations and, for a refusal, the typed refusal. An upstream version or commit that was never recorded stays null (rendered `unknown`) and is never guessed. A provider bound to a pin (`upstream.pin`) goes STALE — every one of its cells reads `stale`, never its recorded tier — as soon as the pin's commit, version or live_receipts.version differs from `certified_against`; recheck the cells, bump record_version, re-record. runtime/scripts/certification.py validates and renders this file; docs/certification.md explains it and carries the first-run guide.

tiers.live-witnessed: A real upstream build and a real harness ran this route end to end; the evidence is a docs/runs/ report whose RUN: header binds (verifier=GREEN, cited as a mission's proof_evidence). Exact upstream and harness versions are recorded.
tiers.fixture-tested: The fleet's own code for this route runs in CI against an in-repo fixture — a scripted upstream transport or the first_run.py inert worker. Proves the fleet's side of the route; proves nothing about the upstream build or the harness.
tiers.source-only: The route's launch or flags were written from reading upstream source or docs; no test drives this exact route.
tiers.unsupported: The fleet refuses this route before any launch, with the typed refusal named in `refusal`.
tiers.unavailable: Advertised, but no evidence of any kind exists in this repository: the route's state is unknown.
